gold.user: User requests to retrieve a list of all plans available in the Jira Cloud platform.
gold.ideal: A successful response with a list of plans, including their IDs, names, and statuses.

gold.user: User wants to create a new plan for managing project timelines and resources.
gold.ideal: A successful response indicating the plan has been created, along with the new plan's ID and details.

gold.user: User needs to view the details of a specific plan identified by its ID.
gold.ideal: A successful response containing detailed information about the specified plan.

gold.user: User wants to update the details of an existing plan to reflect new project requirements.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming the plan has been updated with the new details.

gold.user: User decides to archive a plan that is no longer active to keep the workspace organized.
gold.ideal: A successful response indicating the plan has been archived.

gold.user: User wants to create a duplicate of an existing plan to use as a template for a new project.
gold.ideal: A successful response with the details of the newly created duplicate plan.

gold.user: User intends to move a plan to the trash as it is no longer needed.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming the plan has been moved to the trash.
